AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
